description:
Profit margin and markup from cost and price, or the price for a target.

    Use for: 'profit margin calculator nz', 'margin vs markup', 'what price for a 30%
    margin', 'markup percentage calculator', 'gross margin formula'.

    Margin = profit / price; markup = profit / cost. Cost $60, price $100: $40 profit,
    40% margin, 66.67% markup. A 40% margin on $60 cost needs a $100 price.

    Args:
        cost: Your cost, more than zero.
        price: The selling price (or give one target instead).
        target_margin_percent: Margin wanted, under 100.
        target_markup_percent: Markup wanted.

    Returns:
        price, profit, margin_percent, markup_percent, cost and profit ratios.
name: profit_margin_calculator
